title: A bug's --repro run at filing writes nothing into the filer's own item tree, so a worker never hand-edits an item file to undo it
goal: backlog.py new bug runs a --repro command in an isolated copy (or refuses one that writes an item file), so a worker filing a bug whose repro runs backlog.py adds no gate or field to its own claimed item; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: BG-2rh4u36u's worker filed a bug whose repro added a stray gate g2 to BG-2rh4u36u and removed it by a hand edit of the item JSON

run:
import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile, json
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
rel = bl_base.rel_dir()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, rel))
iid = "ST-aaaaaaaa"
item = {"id": iid, "kind": "story", "title": "claimed", "status": "doing", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g", "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["_tools/x.py"]}
path = os.path.join(d, rel, iid + ".json")
text = json.dumps(item, indent=2) + "\n"
open(path, "w").write(text)
code = "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); p.write_text(p.read_text()+chr(32)); sys.exit(1)"
cmd = "python3 -c \"" + code + "\" " + os.path.join(rel, iid + ".json")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, "new", "bug", "--title", "planted repro writes an item file", "--goal", "x is fixed", "--severity", "S3", "--repro", cmd, "--repro-reason", "planted"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.returncode, r.stdout[-200:], r.stderr[-200:])
ok = open(path).read() == text
print("filer item file unchanged by the repro run:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
